workbook_workflow.generator: scripts/build_workbooks.py (--only screening); one copy per reviewer, generated from this template, fulltext_exclusion_codes.json, screening_manual.md, calibration_plan.md and 03_search/search_log_template.json
workbook_workflow.merge_and_agreement: scripts/merge_screening.py merge --stage TA|FT; prisma for flow counts
workbook_workflow.independence_rule: Each reviewer decides only in their own workbook and locks it; the SHA-256 of each locked workbook is recorded here and committed to git before any merge; reviewers do not see each other's decisions before both are locked.
workbook_workflow.exports: CSV exports of reviewer sheets and merge outputs are versioned in git; no Rayyan/Covidence.
workbook_workflow.AI_role: AI may prepare, transform, check and summarise; it never decides eligibility or acts as reviewer/adjudicator.

pass_rule.sampling: random without replacement from the sorted frozen deduplicated draft pool
pass_rule.agreement_metric: raw agreement on the binary TA disposition
pass_rule.kappa: Cohen's kappa reported descriptively; no pass threshold
pass_rule.source: 04_screening/calibration_plan.md (human-readable rule; the generator parses the threshold and binary groups from that file, so both must agree)

calibration.timing: After the v3.0 archive release (GitHub Release + Zenodo version DOI) and before the formal search; if the pilot changes rules, release v3.1 with justification.
concept_comparison_items: Core A identifiable bout and post-cessation timing
Support B same marker, same people, >= 2 identified bouts
position relative to the 0-72 h organising window (outside-window samples tagged, not excluded)
adult >= 18 y or separable adult stratum
author open-window framing does not affect eligibility
calibration.repeat_seed_rule: seed = 20261002 + round_number - 1; first repeat round_number=2; exclude all IDs sampled in earlier rounds
calibration.manual_version_rule: Record the screening_manual.md version as the protocol release tag plus git commit SHA used to generate the workbooks.

field_schema.record_id: Stable unique report identifier from the deduplicated formal-search pool.
field_schema.report_id: Bibliographic report identifier; link versions and related reports.
field_schema.cohort_id: Participant cohort identifier; used to prevent double counting.
field_schema.preprint_linked_publication_id: Record identifier for version linkage, if applicable.
field_schema.title: Record title as exported (records_master.title).
field_schema.doi: DOI exactly as exported; text, no URL prefix (records_master.doi).
field_schema.pmid: PubMed ID; text, leading zeros preserved (records_master.pmid).
field_schema.source_database: Database/platform from search_log_template.searches[].database, or the documented supplemental route; several separated by "; " (records_master.source_database).
field_schema.search_id: search_log_template.searches[].id of the export(s) containing the record (records_master.search_id).
field_schema.route: search_log_template route: E AND I, E AND O, or the supplemental route label (records_master.route).
field_schema.dedup_status: One of dedup_status_values; in the Excel records_master a blank dedup_status cell means RETAINED.

conditional.healthy_stratum_extractable_if_mixed: Required only when the cohort mixes healthy and clinical participants.
conditional.adult_or_separable_adult_stratum: TRUE when all participants are >= 18 y or an adult stratum and its results are separable; FALSE establishes FT03.

tagging_only_not_eligibility.post_cessation_sample_within_window: TRUE if at least one post-cessation sample falls within 0-72 h after cessation of the identifiable bout. FALSE (only samples > 72 h) does NOT exclude: the record stays eligible and its samples are tagged outside-window recovery (contract 2.2; no exclusion code).

eligibility_check_semantics.no_intensity_check: No exposure-intensity, duration or mode eligibility check exists (contract 2.1); use exposure_as_reported to record them.

exposure_as_reported.rule: Recording only; never an eligibility criterion. Full values are charted at extraction (sample_sets).

screening_disposition_stage_notes.TA: Title/abstract dispositions; must equal the bold dispositions in screening_manual.md section 3B, from which scripts/build_workbooks.py derives the TA dropdown.
screening_disposition_stage_notes.FT: Full-text dispositions; administrative statuses (DUPLICATE_*, NOT_RETRIEVED, AWAITING_*, FRONTIER_PREPRINT) take no FT code.
screening_disposition_stage_notes.DEDUP: Record preparation (records_master.dedup_status). A duplicate/version recognised later may also be recorded at FT.

dedup_status_values.RETAINED: Unique record, or the retained member of a duplicate/version group; screened. Not a disposition and not an administrative exclusion status. Entered as a blank dedup_status cell in the Excel records_master.
dedup_status_values.DUPLICATE_RECORD: Exact bibliographic duplicate of a retained record (fulltext_exclusion_codes.json administrative status).
dedup_status_values.DUPLICATE_VERSION: Superseded version (for example preprint vs publication) of a retained report (fulltext_exclusion_codes.json administrative status).

field_schema.title_abstract_primary_reason_codes: EXCLUDE_TA primary_reason uses the FT01-FT08 codes from fulltext_exclusion_codes.json (first clearly failed dimension in hierarchy order); there are no separate TA codes. Null for every other TA disposition.

A_B_eligible_allowed_values.note: TRUE/FALSE are the JSON booleans true/false; NR/NA/UNCLEAR follow 05_extraction/data_dictionary.json missing_value_semantics. Scope labels used downstream: A_core_acute, B_support_repeated_bouts, background, excluded, uncertain (contract 8.3g).

record_validation_rules: Field schema describes a blank future record; records remains empty until actual screening.
Two human reviewer decisions are stored independently and locked before reconciliation; AI cannot populate an independent reviewer decision.
Scientific EXCLUDE_FT requires exactly one first-established FT01–FT08 code; administrative statuses require null primary exclusion codes.
EXCLUDE_TA requires exactly one primary_reason from FT01-FT08 (first clearly failed dimension); other TA dispositions require a null primary_reason.
INCLUDE_B or INCLUDE_A_AND_B requires source evidence for same immune marker, same individuals, >=2 identifiable bouts, post-cessation timing and baseline/comparator.
Keep retrieval, translation, publication/version and eligibility states separately; missing information is not an established exclusion.
Pilot records count formally only if identified through documented formal search/citation chasing; pilot_rounds stores actual results only.
NR = not reported; NA = inapplicable; UNCLEAR = genuinely ambiguous. Null fields here are unpopulated template values, not negative findings.
Participants < 18 y, or a mixed-age cohort without a separable adult stratum, establish FT03; older adults are eligible and flagged as a subgroup.
There is no exposure-intensity, duration or mode eligibility check; exposure_as_reported is recording only.
post_cessation_sample_within_window = FALSE (only samples > 72 h) never establishes an exclusion; samples are tagged outside-window recovery. FT05 applies only to during-only sampling.
Use of the term 'open window' or the authors' stance on it never affects eligibility.
Each reviewer's locked workbook SHA-256 is recorded in workbook_workflow.locks (and calibration.reviewer_workbook_sha256 for the pilot) and committed to git before merge_screening.py is run.
